correctness.rationale: Flow decomposition into 0-1 source/sink path vertices is valid; strict convexity in each argument puts every maximizer at vertices. For path indicators the squared distance equals the symmetric-difference edge count. Adding a missing internal vertex increases this distance, so the union covers all internal vertices. Shared edges then correspond exactly to adjacent common vertices; removing one endpoint of a shared edge from one path increases the distance, excluding shared edges at an optimum. The remaining common core must be an independent set in the path on 3..N-2, of cardinal floor((N-3)/2). Independent-set maximum placement yields one odd and k-1 even cores; k private vertices have 2^(k-1) unordered assignments. Cases N=3,4 and nonvertex points were explicitly checked; no enumerative inference is used for all N.
